cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import harness; harness.setup_env()
import reference, formats, pipeline
norm = lambda o: json.dumps(o, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))

lead = [1100+i for i in range(15)]
tail = [1400+i for i in range(6)]
a = [1600]*9
b = [1603,1603,1603,1603,1602,1602,1602,1601,1600]
acts = [0]*15 + [1000]*9 + [0]*6
def row(vals):
    return {'class': 0, 'values': lead + vals + tail, 'activation': acts}
print('squares', sum((x-y)**2 for x,y in zip(a,b)))
for eps in ([7,5], [140,100], [13999,10000], [14001,10000]):
    req = {'capacity':{'range':8,'exact':8},
     'releases':[{ 'id':'m','classes':1,'width':9,'eps':eps,'ratio':[0,1],'threshold':[0,1],
       'mode':'range','packet_limit':9,'idle_us':0,'discovery':[row(a),row(b)],
       'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1600]*9},{'class':0,'values':[1700]*9}],
       'validation':[{'class':0,'values':[1600]*9}]}],'blocks':[]}
    out = pipeline.execute(formats.validate(json.loads(json.dumps(req))))
    cat = out['catalog'][0]
    d = (49/9)**0.5*0.6
    print(eps, 'eps_float=%r' % (eps[0]/eps[1]), 'dist_float=%r'%d,
          'clusters=%d' % len(cat['clusters']), 'members=%s' % ([c['members'] for c in cat['clusters']],),
          'range=%s' % ([c['range'] for c in cat['clusters']],))
PYEOF
